scripts.pretest: npm run lint:fix && npm run flow
scripts.prepublish: not-in-publish || npm run prepublishOnly
scripts.postversion: auto-changelog && git add CHANGELOG.md && git commit --no-edit --amend && git tag -f "v$(node -e "console.log(require('./package.json').version)")"
scripts.test:examples: npm run test-example:legacy && npm run test-example:flat-esm && npm run test-example:flat-cjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: safe-publish-latest && npm run lint && npm run flow && npm run tests-only
scripts.test-example:legacy: cd examples/legacy && npm install && npm run lint
scripts.test-example:flat-cjs: cd examples/flat-cjs && npm install && npm run lint
scripts.test-example:flat-esm: cd examples/flat-esm && npm install && npm run lint
scripts.generate-list-of-rules: eslint-doc-generator --rule-doc-title-format prefix-name --rule-doc-section-options false --config-emoji recommended,☑️ --ignore-config flat/recommended --ignore-config flat/strict
